tasks.title: Agricultural Economics
paras: Agricultural economics has undergone significant changes, driven by advancements in technology and shifts in consumer demand. Precision farming utilizes satellite imagery to enhance crop yields by analyzing soil and weather conditions. This allows farmers to make informed decisions about planting, watering, harvesting, which in turn increase efficiency and reduce waste.

Another development is the rise of organic farming, which responds to consumer preference for sustainable products. Organic farming avoids synthetic pesticides and fertilizers, focusing on crop rotation, composting, and biological pest control. This practice has environmental benefits and creates niche markets for farmers.

Global trade also impacts agricultural economics. Nations depend on importing and exporting food to meet domestic needs and take advantage of international prices. However, this interdependency can lead to economic vulnerability when global supply chains are disrupted by political instability or natural disasters.

Innovations and global dynamics can also pose other challenges. Precision farming requires significant investment in technology, which can be prohibitive for small - scale farmers. Organic farming often yields lower outputs than conventional methods, complicating the balance between sustainability and food security. Additionally, reliance on global trade exposes countries to fluctuations in international markets, necessitating robust economic policies to manage these risks.

questions.stem: The word “enhance” in the passage is closest in meaning to
questions.analysis: 正确答案：D 题型：词汇题 原文定位：Precision farming…to enhance crop yields by analyzing soil and weather conditions. 解析：enhance 意为 “提升、增进”，文中指提高农作物产量。 选项分析： A. maintain（维持），无提升含义，不符。 B. imitate（模仿），语义无关。 C. predict（预测），语境不匹配。 D. improve（改善、提高），与 enhance 同义，正确。

questions.stem: What is suggested in the passage about organic farming?

options.A: It uses synthetic pesticides and fertilizers.
options.B: It does not create niche markets for farmers.
options.C: It focuses on natural and sustainable practices.
options.D: It is just as efficient as conventional farming.

questions.analysis: 正确答案：C 题型：细节理解题 原文定位：Organic farming avoids synthetic pesticides…focusing on crop rotation, composting, and biological pest control /consumer preference for sustainable products 解析：有机农业拒绝人工合成农资，采用自然方式种植，主打可持续理念。 选项分析： A. 使用合成农药化肥，与原文完全相反，错误。 B. 无法创造小众市场，原文明确可以创造，错误。 C. 注重自然、可持续生产方式，贴合原文，正确。 D. 效率和传统农业一致，后文提及产量更低、效率更差，错误。

questions.stem: What does the passage suggest is an economic vulnerability of global trade in agricultural economics?
questions.analysis: 正确答案：C 题型：细节理解题 原文定位：this interdependency can lead to economic vulnerability… 解析：各国农业高度互相依赖、依附国际市场，容易受外界冲击，造成经济风险。 选项分析： A. 精准农业技术，属于农业科技，和贸易风险无关。 B. 有机产品需求，是农业发展趋势，并非弱点。 C. 依赖国际市场，对应 interdependency，正确。 D. 新技术投入，属于农业挑战，不属于贸易弊端。

questions.stem: Why does the author mention “political instability or natural disasters”?

options.A: To identify situations in which dependence on global trade can have negative consequences
options.B: To provide examples of factors that have an insignificant influence on agricultural economics
options.C: To emphasize the importance of organic farming
options.D: To demonstrate how technological advancements can solve problems

questions.analysis: 正确答案：A 题型：修辞目的题 原文定位：global supply chains are disrupted by political instability or natural disasters 解析：举例两类突发危机，说明过度依赖全球贸易会遭遇负面冲击。 选项分析： A. 指出依赖国际贸易会引发不良后果，贴合段落逻辑，正确。 B. 说明影响微弱，与原文严重破坏供应链相反。 C. 强调有机农业重要性，本段主题为全球贸易，无关。 D. 证明科技可以解决问题，本段无相关表述。

questions.stem: The passage mentions all of the following challenges related to new agricultural practices EXCEPT

options.B: a need for investments that small - scale farmers cannot afford
options.C: a possible decrease in food security
options.D: too much dependence on international markets

questions.analysis: 正确答案：A 题型：细节排除题 原文定位：①costly technology for small farmers②lower outputs, affect food security③rely on global trade, market risks 解析：题干选出文中未提到的挑战。 选项分析： A. environmental problems（环境问题），文中只讲优势，未将其列为新农业的挑战，正确。 B. 小农户负担不起高额投入，原文明确提及，排除。 C. 威胁粮食安全平衡，原文对应内容，排除。 D. 过度依赖国际市场，属于贸易风险，排除。
